profile_text.body:
Datadog, Inc. is a public company traded under the ticker DDOG, with CIK 0001561550, headquartered in New York, NY. Its website describes its core offering as cloud monitoring as a service, which it says lets customers see metrics from all of their apps, tools and services in one place, and it offers a free trial.

The site also presents security alongside monitoring. Datadog describes integrating security and observability so that organizations can decode runtime execution, eliminate exposure in dynamic AI environments, and carry out detection and response with what it calls agentic speed, which it frames as a defense against AI-powered attacks.

Its litigation record lists no individual cases, and its law exposure is recorded in New York with a count of 458.
